question: The value of 96 - 4 of (18 - 13) + 4 × 7 is:
solution:
**Given:**

⇒ 96 - 4 of (18 - 13) + 4 × 7

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f0b51ba6d992ac99275b5675ba8c9abe6854e87c791b453763945dee34791a7.png] 

⇒ 96 - 4 of 5 + 4 × 7

⇒ 96 - 20 + 4 × 7

⇒ 96 - 20 + 28

⇒ 124 - 20

⇒ 104

**∴ 104 is the correct Answer.**
